sentences.japanese: 我々は、日常生活の中に多くの義務や責任を担っている。

sentences.english: The old man was run over and immediately taken to hospital.

sentences.english: Being seen off by my whole family I shouldered a rucksack, stocked with my trip supplies.

sentences.japanese: この梱包材が断熱機能を担っている。
